description: Source code for TaskSetManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for scheduling, retrying, and managing tasks within a task set, including handling locality, speculation, failures, and executor loss.

classes.name: TaskSetManager
classes.description: Manages scheduling, retries, and failure handling for a set of tasks within Spark, including locality, speculation, and executor loss handling.

classes.name: PendingTasksByLocality
classes.description: Holds pending tasks categorized by locality levels such as executor, host, rack, no preference, and any.

classes.name: BarrierPendingLaunchTask
classes.description: Represents a pending barrier task with associated resource and locality info.

classes.name: TaskProcessRateCalculator
classes.description: Helps determine if tasks are running inefficiently to decide on speculative execution.

methods.name: addPendingTask
methods.description: Adds a task to pending lists based on its preferred locations and locality.

methods.name: dequeueTaskFromList
methods.description: Removes and returns a task index from a pending list if eligible.

methods.name: resourceOffer
methods.description: Handles resource offers by assigning tasks based on locality and availability.

methods.name: prepareLaunchingTask
methods.description: Prepares a task for launch, serializes it, and updates bookkeeping.

methods.name: handleSuccessfulTask
methods.description: Marks a task as successful, updates metrics, and kills other attempts.

methods.name: handleFailedTask
methods.description: Handles task failure, retries, and potential aborts based on failure count.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the entire task set due to unrecoverable failure.

methods.name: checkAndSubmitSpeculatableTasks
methods.description: Identifies and submits tasks for speculative execution based on runtime.
